content_sections.text: Download the application form and details from the official website www.esic.gov.in. Print the prescribed application form on A4 size paper. Fill up the application form properly and completely. Prepare the required Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. I” payable at Kolkata. Gather all original documents, certificates, and self-attested photocopies as specified in the notification. Report in person between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM for document verification at the Academic Block, 2nd Floor of ESI-PGIMSR & ESIC Medical College, Joka on the scheduled interview date. Submit the filled application form and attend the walk-in interview before the Selection Board.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: One set of the prescribed application form filled and signed Two copies of recent self-attested color passport size photographs Proof of age (Date of Birth certificate) Category certificates (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) in updated Government of India Format Educational qualifications certificates (Matriculation, Higher Secondary, Graduate, Post Graduate, and any other) Registration certificate issued by State Medical Council/MCI MCI recognized teaching experience certificate issued by the Head of the Institute or Head of the Department Research Publications in Indexed Journals Pension Payment Order (PPO), in case of retired employees from Govt. organizations NOC for in-service candidates from employer Service bond release certificate, if applicable No objection certificate from present employer, in case of Government employees

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by ESIC Medical College Kolkata?
faq.answer: ESIC Medical College Kolkata is conducting a walk-in interview recruitment for Teaching Faculty posts including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 61 vacancies are available across various departments for Professor (07), Associate Professor (19), and Assistant Professor (35) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the dates for the walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews and document verifications are scheduled for 14 October 2026 and 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM at the Academic Block 2nd Floor of ESI-PGIMSR & ESIC Medical College, Joka. Candidates reporting beyond 10:30 AM will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 69 years on the date of document verification and interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for general category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for all other categories is Rs. 500/-, payable via Demand Draft in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. I” payable at Kolkata.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for female and SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is NIL for SC, ST, Regular ESIC Candidates, Female Candidates, and Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for an Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for an Assistant Professor is Rs. 1,50,294/- per month plus transport allowance with DA.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates engage in private practice during their tenure?
faq.answer: No, private practice is strictly prohibited during the tenure of service in ESIC.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form and notification details from the official website at www.esic.gov.in.
